:::note[Generated]
The `open` tool as the server lists it in `tools/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.3.0-8-ga90b39e595 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.
:::

Open a workspace against a configuration — `tofu init` with its backend settings, plus `tofu workspace select`. The backend comes from the configuration's own backend block; backend_config and backend_config_files supply only what it leaves out. Reads the state (no lock is held: the engine takes the state lock while a convergence runs) and reports its lineage, serial and resource count (state_list lists them) — no lineage and no serial means no statefile yet: the first up writes one. If a convergence already holds the workspace — one this server or an earlier one started — it is reported under convergence with what to do next: apply continues one paused at its approval point, up supersedes it, cancel ends it. var and var_file are kept for the workspace while it is open (names only are ever shown): every later tool on it reads the state with them, so a state-encryption passphrase or a value the backend block reads goes here, once, and each plan command's own var lays over them. Omit workspace_alias for the default workspace; name one to open several, and pass it to every later tool. Opening a workspace already open under the same alias, the same way, returns it as it is; with var or var_file it replaces the values the workspace keeps, once the state reads with them.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** read · plan · apply · full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | false |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_alias` | string | no | Configuration whose backend this is, as registered by init (omit for the configuration init registered without an alias, 'default', however many others are registered). |
| `backend_type` | string | no | Backend type (e.g. 'local', 's3') for a configuration that declares no backend of its own. Omit to use the declared backend — the normal case. A type contradicting a declared backend is refused; edit the declared block to move the store. |
| `backend_config` | object | no | Backend settings merged over the declared ones per key, these winning — 'tofu init -backend-config=key=value'. The place for credentials and per-environment values the backend block deliberately leaves out; a configuration that declares its backend fully needs nothing here. |
| `backend_config_files` | array of string | no | Backend settings files ('tofu init -backend-config=&lt;file>'), in order, merged below backend_config. |
| `var` | object | no | Root input variable values — 'tofu -var' — kept for this workspace while it is open, in this server's memory only: never written down, never shown back (status lists the names). Every later tool on the workspace uses them: state_list, output, show, taint, cancel and apply derive its backend and its state encryption with them, and each plan command lays its own var and var_file over them, name by name. The place for a state-encryption passphrase (passphrase = var.passphrase) and for a value the backend block reads. A string is the raw text a -var carries; any other JSON value is passed as its HCL literal. Opening the workspace again with var or var_file replaces them. |
| `var_file` | array of string | no | Variables files — 'tofu -var-file' — kept with var for this workspace, in order, below var, and read again at each use: name a file that holds a secret rather than reading the secret into the conversation. A relative path is relative to the configuration directory. |
| `workspace_name` | string | no | OpenTofu workspace name — a named state slot inside the backend, what terraform.workspace reads. Defaults to 'default'. It addresses state a 'tofu workspace select' user created. |
| `workspace_alias` | string | no | Alias every later tool passes as workspace_alias. Omit for the default (unnamed) workspace; name one to open several at once. |
| `reconfigure` | boolean | no | Consent to re-binding this workspace's state to a backend that differs from the one the engine recorded for it — 'tofu init -reconfigure'. Taken at the next up (or other plan command). A copied statefile of another workspace is refused regardless. |
| `force_unlock` | boolean | no | Release a stale state lock now — 'tofu force-unlock'. Only when you are certain no other process is using the workspace (a previous server died holding it). |
| `lock_id` | string | no | The lock to release, as the lock error names it; implies force_unlock. Remote (TFC/TFE/Scalr) backends want '&lt;organization>/&lt;workspace>'. |
